title: Switching to a Budgeting App
paragraphs: After years of tracking expenses on paper, Hana finally switched to a digital budgeting app after her sister insisted it would save her hours of manual calculation every single month.
The transition felt uncomfortable at first, since she had to manually enter three months of past transactions before the app could show her any useful patterns in her spending.

Once the initial setup was complete, however, Hana found the automatic categorization surprisingly accurate, and she discovered spending patterns she had never noticed while tracking everything by hand previously.
Six months later, Hana had saved a noticeable amount simply by seeing her habits laid out clearly, proving that the tedious setup process had genuinely been worth the initial effort.
